parts.script:
Alice: Hey, Ben! I was thinking we could go camping this weekend. What do you think?  
Ben: That sounds great! Do you have a specific place in mind?  
Alice: Yes, I was looking at Pine Lake. It’s about an hour’s drive from here.  
Ben: Perfect! I’ve heard it’s beautiful there. What should we bring?  
Alice: We’ll need a tent, sleeping bags, and food, of course.  
Ben: What about cooking gear?  
Alice: Good point! We should take a portable stove and some utensils.  
Ben: Should we invite anyone else?  
Alice: I thought about inviting Sarah and Mark. They love camping too.  
Ben: Great idea! I’ll text them. What time do you want to leave on Saturday?  
Alice: How about 9 AM? We can set up before it gets too hot.  
Ben: Sounds good. I’ll pick up the food on Friday.  
Alice: Awesome! I’ll bring the tent and sleeping bags.  
Ben: This is going to be so much fun!  
Alice: I can’t wait! Let’s make the most of it.
